improve:*.original: yesterday I make a new authentication system
improve:*.improved: yesterday I built a new authentication system
improve:*.why: "Built" sounds more natural when talking about something you created. Past tense: yesterday → built.

explain:*.question: Why "built" instead of "made"?
explain:*.answer: Both are possible. For software, "built" is generally more natural because it emphasises creating or developing a system.

vocabulary:*.meaning: the process of proving who a user is
